title: IPMA, weather warnings open data (warnings_www.json)
what_it_says: IPMA's open data for weather warnings by area; area LSB is the Lisbon district. Read at 16:32 UTC on 10 November 2026, after the article's 14:23 and 14:34 readings: the Lisbon warnings were unchanged. Read again at 18:32 UTC: the rain warning for Wednesday had become red from 12:00 to 18:00 (orange before that). Read a third time at 20:37 UTC: Wednesday's warnings unchanged since 18:32. Read a fourth time at 22:32 UTC (unchanged) and a fifth at 00:32 UTC on 11 November: the red rain warning had moved earlier, to 09:00 to 18:00. Read a sixth time at 02:34 UTC: unchanged since 00:32. Web Summit's Day 2 statement and homepage notice were also unchanged at 02:34. Read a seventh time at 04:32 UTC: unchanged since 00:32 (Web Summit's statement and homepage notice also unchanged). Read an eighth time at 06:32 UTC: unchanged (Web Summit's statement and homepage notice also unchanged). Read a ninth time at 08:32 UTC: unchanged for Wednesday; Tuesday night's yellow sea warning (to 06:00) had expired and left the file. Read a tenth time at 10:32 UTC: the wind warning had been lowered from red to orange. Read an eleventh time at 12:32 UTC: Wednesday's warnings unchanged in level and time (rain red 09:00 to 18:00, wind orange 09:00 to 21:00, sea orange 12:00 to 21:00). Read a twelfth time at 14:32 UTC: IPMA had reissued the Lisbon warnings at 12:34 UTC, lower and shorter (rain red 12:34 to 15:00 then yellow to 18:00; wind orange 12:34 to 18:00, gusts to 90 km/h; sea orange 12:34 to 21:00). Read a thirteenth time at 16:32 UTC: IPMA had reissued the Lisbon warnings at 15:06 UTC and no red warning remained (rain yellow 15:06 to 18:00; wind orange 15:06 to 18:00; sea orange 15:06 to 21:00). Read a fourteenth time at 18:32 UTC: IPMA had reissued the Lisbon warnings at 15:56 UTC; the wind warning was gone, rain yellow until 18:00, sea orange until 21:00. Read a fifteenth time at 20:32 UTC: IPMA had reissued the Lisbon warnings at 19:09 UTC and only the sea warning (orange to 21:00, then yellow to 03:00) remained. Read a sixteenth time at 22:32 UTC: only a yellow sea warning (21:00 to 03:00) remained.
